extraction_notes: BC846BLT1G is the BC846B gain grade in SOT-23 (Pb-free, marking 1B, 3000/tape and reel), confirmed in the ordering information table on p. 12.
This is a multi-variant datasheet (BC846/847/848/849/850, A/B/C grades). All extracted values use the BC846B rows: VCEO 65 V, VCBO 80 V, VEBO 6.0 V, hFE group B.

Typical curves for BC846B were taken from the pages headed 'BC846B, SBC846B' (Figures 10-18, p. 5-6). Only the 25 degC curves were digitized; readings are by-eye estimates from the printed figures with roughly 5-10 percent uncertainty.
All values converted to SI base units: currents in A, capacitances in F, frequencies in Hz (datasheet axes use mA, pF, MHz in places).
Guaranteed limits are preserved with source_kind minimum/maximum and were not converted to typicals: hFE at 2.0 mA min 200/max 450, VCE(sat) maxima 0.25 V and 0.6 V, fT min 100 MHz, Cobo max 4.5 pF.
No tabulated input capacitance (Cibo) exists in this datasheet; cibo is a digitized typical point from the Cib curve of Figure 17. Figure 17 does not state a measurement frequency.

Additional guaranteed values not representable in this schema: V(BR)CBO min 80 V, V(BR)EBO min 6.0 V, ICBO max 15 nA at VCB = 30 V (25 degC), VBE(on) 580-700 mV at IC = 2.0 mA / VCE = 5.0 V, IC(max) 100 mA continuous, NF max 10 dB.
Safe operating area for BC846A/BC846B is Figure 37 on p. 11; not digitized as it is outside the schema's curve intent for Gummel-Poon fitting.
